## Cost, latency, consistency

| | classifier | LLM | classifier + LLM fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| cost per 1,000 tickets | 1.85 CPU-seconds (no per-call fee) | $0.117 | $0.012 |
| latency median / p95 per ticket | 1.8 / 2.5 ms | 1755 / 4003 ms | LLM latency on deferred tickets only |
| macro-F1 (200) | 0.939 | 0.779 | 0.923 |
| accuracy (200) | 0.935 | 0.805 | 0.920 |

- LLM tokens per ticket: 410 in, 93 out. Price: $0.15/1M input, $0.6/1M output (https://console.groq.com/docs/model/openai/gpt-oss-120b (read 2026-11-01)). Completion tokens include any reasoning tokens the model reports.
- LLM latency includes any 429 backoff waits, so the p95 is an upper bound for a quiet account.
- Consistency: the LLM gave the identical label on 49 of 50 tickets classified twice.
- Deferred by the classifier at threshold 0.7: 20 of 200 (10.0%). On those tickets: classifier accuracy 0.65, LLM accuracy 0.5 (the threshold choice assumed the LLM would be right on them).
- Full test set classifier (n=3196): macro-F1 0.954.
